subject: The feature I built at 3AM for you
preview_text: I didn't plan to share this, but it's live now. One click inside the app.
body_paragraphs: Last Thursday, 3AM, I was staring at a blank screen myself. Deadline tomorrow, zero words, and my brain was fried. So I coded something I never meant to ship—a rewrite engine that turns your rushed draft into a polished A-grade paper in under two minutes.

I wasn't going to release it. But then I thought about you, stuck at 2AM with the same panic. So I pushed it live just for users who've been with us a while. No announcement, no fanfare. Just this email.

Open the app. Tap the 'Humanize & Polish' tab. Paste in your messiest paragraph. Watch it rewrite in real time with citations, flow fixes, and anti-AI detection baked in. It's not in the docs. It's not in any tutorial. It's my late-night gift to you.

One click. That's all it takes. Open Thesis Generator now and hit the tab labeled '3AM Special'—it'll only be there until I decide to pull it. P.S. This also works on your old drafts from last semester. Go dig one up and see what it does.
